checks.message: 153 of 153 consecutive balance links are consistent.

issues.message: On 1 day(s) the statement prints transactions in an order that differs from posting order; they were re-sequenced within the day so that the printed balances chain.
No printed opening balance was found; the opening balance is derived from the first transaction, so rows missing before it would not be detectable.
No printed closing balance was found; rows missing after the last extracted transaction would not be detectable from the balances.

balances.basis: Printed running balances (end of day), carried forward on days without transactions.

income.estimated_monthly_income_basis: Median monthly external inflow over full months (excludes own-account transfers, refunds, loan disbursals and investment redemptions; includes cash deposits).

salary_like.description: No credits with salary-related narration were identified.

insights: Largest outflow category: EMI / loan repayment (22.65% of debits).
22.65% of outflows go to EMI, loan or credit-card repayments.

emi.foir_income_basis: Median monthly external inflow over full months (excludes own-account transfers, refunds, loan disbursals and investment redemptions; includes cash deposits).
foir_notes: FOIR = estimated monthly EMI ÷ estimated monthly income × 100.
Includes recurring NACH/ECS debits with no lender or EMI wording (possible EMIs); these may also be SIPs, insurance or subscriptions.
Monthly income is volatile, so the income used for FOIR is uncertain.
Only debits from this account are visible; obligations paid from other accounts are not included.
emi.note: Obligations are estimated from recurring debits only. They are not verified loan liabilities; outstanding principal, interest rate and sanctioned amount cannot be derived from a bank statement.

bounces.note: Confirmed events are based on explicit narration. Pattern-based reversals are indicative only. A return charge alone does not establish which obligation was missed or prove a loan default.

risk_indicators.title: Returned payments / return charges
risk_indicators.description: 6 transaction(s) explicitly reference a return, bounce or return charge (3 charge(s), ₹708.00).
limitations: A return charge alone does not identify which obligation was missed or prove a loan default.

risk_indicators.title: Volatile monthly inflows
risk_indicators.description: Monthly external inflows vary widely (coefficient of variation 104.81% over 11 months).
limitations: Seasonal businesses and irregular bonuses also produce high variability.

risk_indicators.title: Outflows exceed inflows in most months
risk_indicators.description: Net cash flow was negative in 7 of 11 full months.
limitations: Drawing down accumulated savings also produces monthly deficits.

risk_indicators.title: Large inflows moved out quickly
risk_indicators.description: 3 large credit(s) of at least ₹50,000 were followed within one day by outflows of 80% or more of the amount.
limitations: Business payments, property or vehicle purchases legitimately show this pattern.
This is not an indication of fraud by itself.

risk_indicators.title: Transactions much larger than usual
risk_indicators.description: 7 transaction(s) are at least 10x the account's median transaction and ₹50,000+.
limitations: Unusual size alone does not indicate anything improper.

risk_indicators.title: Sharp change in transaction volume
risk_indicators.description: 1 month-to-month change(s) of 60% or more in transaction count.
limitations: Volume changes can reflect seasonality or a change of primary account.
This analysis is generated automatically from the uploaded bank statement only. It is not issued or endorsed by any bank and does not replace independent verification.
Counterparty names are read from transaction narrations on a best-effort basis; banks often truncate them.
Categories come from deterministic narration rules and are indicative, with a confidence per transaction.
Salary-like income, recurring inflows and EMI obligations are estimates from transaction patterns, not verified income or loan liabilities.
No credit score, eligibility or lending decision is produced. Indicators describe observed patterns and do not establish fraud, creditworthiness or default.
